verdict.rationale: Operating the product through natural-language commands is a fair question for a government digital-service provider that runs online tools and portals. Nothing in the evidence shows the IRS offering a conversational or natural-language interface. The documented channels are form-based web assistants, XML-based MeF and IRIS A2A machine rails, and paper, mail or fax paths, none of which takes natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
